# Trafalgar Fire

> > Trafalgar Fire supplies passive fire protection systems and fire-rated products for building compliance and safety across Australia.

Trafalgar Fire specializes in passive fire systems including fire dampers, fire collars, fire sealants, and intumescent safety solutions. The company provides comprehensive fire protection products and rectification upgrades to meet Australian building codes and compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- Passive Fire Systems
- Fire Dampers
- Fire Collars
- Fire Sealants
- Building Compliance
- Fire Safety Solutions
- FYRE STOP SYSTEMS
- Intumescent Safety Solutions
- Fire-Rated Products
- Rectification Upgrades
- AS1851 Standards
- Air Transfer Grille Fire Damper
- SuperSTOPPER
- ArmaFlex Protect
- BladeRUNNER
